t: The Forge Steel Mixed Screwdriver Set offers a comprehensive collection of essential hand tools for a wide range of fastening and repair tasks, making it ideal for trade professionals and serious DIYers undertaking general maintenance, automotive work, or intricate electronics repairs. This versatile kit includes a 100mm slotted screwdriver, 2 x 100mm Phillips screwdrivers, a bit driver, precision bit driver, socket adaptor, 10 precision bits (slotted, Phillips and Torx), 19 bits (slotted, Phillips, Pozi, Torx and hex), 9 x 1/4" sockets (4-12mm), and 8 hex keys (1.5-6mm). Crafted with durable chrome vanadium steel for enhanced strength and longevity, the set also features comfortable bi-material handles for improved grip and magnetised tips for secure fastener handling. All components are neatly organised within an ergonomic, portable carry case for convenient transport and storage, making it a reliable choice for any job.
